refresh.trigger: ADR section 8 review or tool evaluation update

proposals.proposal: Pin Semble 0.6.1, Graphify 0.9.71, RTK 0.50.0, and clef-flash as measured in P0 baseline.
proposals.rejectedAlternative: Unpinned floating latest releases or dynamic plugin discovery.

proposals.proposal: Maintain the vetted alternative tools shortlist (>20k stars for main, <=20k for small) under permissive licenses (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD), with Serena excluded per ADR section 1.
proposals.rejectedAlternative: Reopening Serena exclusion or admitting AGPL/proprietary tools to the active stack.

proposals.proposal: Semantic indexes are project-scoped, built on demand by dedicated adapters, cached locally under project state, and purged on clean; the runtime does not own long-running indexing daemons.
proposals.rejectedAlternative: Global background indexer daemon with automatic file system watchers.

proposals.proposal: Keep lexical tokenisation (tokenize word splitting, length >= 2) aligned between retrieval and benchmark until multilingual/code-specific tokeniser evaluation in feature 079.
proposals.rejectedAlternative: Introducing heavy BPE/WordPiece tokenisation dependency prior to measured comparative evaluation.

proposals.proposal: Gate hybrid activation on task success non-regression (>= -0.05 points) and code conceptual-discovery recall@10 improvement (>= +0.10, CI lower > 0), requiring user approval before promotion.
proposals.rejectedAlternative: Promoting semantic retrieval based solely on ranking metrics without end-to-end task success evidence.

proposals.proposal: Define tiered retrieval profiles (e.g. lexical-only fallback vs semantic-augmented) governed by capability declarations and latency budgets.
proposals.rejectedAlternative: Single unconfigurable retrieval pipeline for all harnesses and execution modes.
